facts.fact: The FY2026 Summary of Expenditure Estimates gives the Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation (Head 135) a proposed NLe 46,808,900 for 2026, of which the domestic development column is nil and development of NLe 1,062,400 is foreign-funded; this is the tabled estimate, not an enacted appropriation.
facts.system: Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation budget, FY2026 (Head 135)

note: No FY2025 figure in the document, so no rose or fell; the NLe 34.84m September 2025 figure is the ministry's own request for the same year.
